\section{Additional Results}\label{app:results}

\input{tables/res_mcnemar}

Table~\ref{tab:mcnemar} lists the 18 pre-registered McNemar tests (Sec.~\ref{sec:rq2}).
Table~\ref{tab:full-main} gives the confusion counts of every run on \Deb.
It includes the ablations: the read-out head without LoRA, the unmerged LoRA adapters,
and the secondary thresholds for Jev and Intern-Decision, which were frozen on dev before the eval runs.
% src: juliet_full/llm/results/jev_thresholds.json; juliet_full/lane_reports/2026-11-23_gpu_stage2.md (Intern-Decision thresholds frozen on layer1 dev)
These thresholds are descriptive, so the main text reports the default decision rule.
With them, Jev L3 changes from \res{jev_L3-layer1}{macro} to \res{jev_th2_L3-layer1}{macro}
and Intern-Decision L3 from \res{intern_L3-layer1}{macro} to \res{intern_th2_L3-layer1}{macro}.
The secondary threshold does not remove Intern-Decision's false alarms on \Dead{}
(L3 specificity \res{intern_th2_L3-layer3}{spec}; Table~\ref{tab:full-layers}).
Table~\ref{tab:folds} gives the LoRA results per cross-validation fold.
Fold~1 has the lowest \Dead{} AUROC for both input levels
(\res{x}{auroc_lora_L1_layer3_f1} for L1 and \res{x}{auroc_lora_L3_layer3_f1} for L3).
